content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"registered user","i_want":"to edit an existing task's title, description, priority and Due Date","so_that":"my task list stays accurate when the details of a task change","business_description":"The user can update an existing task through the same form used to create tasks. Editable fields are Title, Description, Priority and Due Date, and they follow the same validation rules as creation. The backend saves the change, and the frontend shows success or error feedback only after the backend responds.","business_value":"Users can correct mistakes and reschedule work without deleting and recreating tasks, which keeps the task history and Creation Date intact.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title to another non-empty value of 100 characters or fewer, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title, sets the Last Updated Date to the time of the update, and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task with a valid title, description, priority and Due Date","when":"The user changes the description, priority and Due Date to other allowed values and submits the form","then":"The backend stores each changed value and the frontend displays a success message after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a missing mandatory field error, the task keeps its previous title, and the form shows the error message 'Title is mandatory'"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with a title of 100 characters","when":"The user changes the title to 101 characters and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title must be 100 characters or fewer is shown"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns a success response","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"An update request has been sent for an existing task and the backend has not yet responded","when":"The edit form is waiting for the response","then":"The task list still shows the previous values for that task and no success message is shown"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"},{"given":"An existing task with a Last Updated Date of 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC","when":"An update request for that task is rejected by validation","then":"The Last Updated Date remains 2024-05-10 10:00:00 UTC"},{"given":"An existing task and an update request with a Priority value outside Low, Medium and High, for example Urgent","when":"The backend validates the request","then":"The backend returns an invalid input error, the stored task is unchanged, and the frontend shows an error message"}],"edge_cases":["Title of exactly 100 characters is accepted; title of 101 characters is rejected","Title containing only spaces is treated as empty and rejected (open question: the PRD does not state whether leading or trailing spaces are trimmed)","Due Date equal to the Creation Date is accepted","Due Date earlier than the Creation Date is rejected and the Creation Date is not changed by an update","Clearing the Description is not addressed by the PRD (open question: whether an empty Description is allowed on update)","Update request with a Status value is out of scope for this story; status changes belong to the status change story","Update request for a task that is deleted by another user while the form is open returns Task Not Found and the form shows an error"],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["PUT /tasks/{id} updates Title, Description, Priority and Due Date and applies the same validation as task creation","Title validation rejects empty and over-100-character titles on update","Due Date validation rejects a Due Date earlier than the Creation Date on update","Last Updated Date is set on successful update and unchanged on rejected update","Task Not Found, Invalid Input and Missing Mandatory Field errors are returned with the simple error handling approach","Edit form pre-fills existing values and reuses the create form","Frontend shows success or error message after each update and never shows an updated state before the backend succeeds","Automated tests cover API and form paths for each acceptance criterion"]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add PUT /tasks/{id} endpoint to update title, description, priority and Due Date","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add the update endpoint for an existing task. Reuse the title and Due Date validation from task creation. Return Task Not Found for unknown IDs, Invalid Input for out-of-range Priority, and Missing Mandatory Field for an absent or null title. Call PUT /tasks/{id} on submit and show success or error feedback based only on the backend response.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Edit form shows existing values for the four editable fields","Success message is shown only after the backend returns success","Error message is shown and the task is not shown as updated when the backend fails","Task list keeps previous values while the request is pending"]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for editing an existing task across API and form","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Automated tests for the update endpoint and the edit form covering validation, not-found handling, error and success feedback, and the pending state.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-9b30a145","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-d57336f7","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc","R-0b1853d6","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover each acceptance criterion of the story","Tests confirm the stored data is unchanged after each rejected update","Tests confirm no success message is shown before the backend responds"]}]}
